citations.claim: approach W (index 3) waited 201s at red with 88 queued while phase stuck on NS green at first violating step 204
approach E (index 1) also starved at red with 87 queued at step 204
starvation building earlier: W waiting at red with growing queue while NS green at step 100

explanation: With actuated control, green switching/recall appears driven by detector-visible demand. Detector_fail on N+E+W hides EW demand, so controller keeps NS green indefinitely and never recalls EW, letting EW red-wait with growing queues exceed 200s max_wait.

violation.detail: approach 3 has waited 201 s at red with vehicles queued (limit 200)

vision_note: The east-west approaches hold long queues of blue vehicles at red signals while the north-south direction stays green across steps 201-204. Despite the large east-west backlog, the signals never change and none of the queued vehicles discharge.
